clear_cells: selected visible dry undesignated floors with zero building and unit occupancy
additional_potential_cells: unobserved or otherwise eligible unit-occupied selected floors
furnishing_targets: excluded from both graphs regardless of observed occupancy
roots: canonical first area for connected projects; own area for independent recipes
approaches: cardinal neighbor of each original furnishing, never the furnishing cell
tie_break: BFS x-minus,y-minus,y-plus,x-plus; shortest distance then coordinate tuple for approaches
goal_truth: false if any endpoint lacks even a potential route; otherwise unknown if any lacks a clear route; otherwise true
joint_stability: terrain, occupancy, receipt-linked furnishings and all required clear routes in one sampled window
source_binding: exact decoded map witness plus original regenerated room plan plus complete circulation evidence
